rationale_overall: At cap=2, MSFT and NVDA both cleared the dated-signal bar. NVDA posted a strong Q2 FY25 (Aug 28: record $26.3B data-center revenue +154% YoY, fresh $50B buyback) plus demand pull-through (Oracle's Sep 12 Blackwell pre-orders); a Sep 11 DOJ antitrust subpoena is a watch-item not a breach. MSFT's Sep 20 20-year PPA with Constellation to restart Three Mile Island for AI power directly underwrites the nuclear leg of the AI wave, reinforcing its thesis and giving incidental nuclear exposure without a dedicated SMR ticker. Pass-1 across the other waves turned up only general commentary or post-date events. No swap warranted. Hold MSFT/NVDA.
